effects.label: Display Glitch
Display Glitch V2
Scroll ← Left
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-scroll-left { from { transform: translate3d(0,0,0); } to { transform: translate3d(var(--sl-pat-tx, -10px), 0, 0); } }

effects.label: Scroll → Right
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-scroll-right { from { transform: translate3d(var(--sl-pat-tx, -10px), 0, 0); } to { transform: translate3d(0,0,0); } }

effects.label: Scroll ↑ Up
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-scroll-up { from { transform: translate3d(0,0,0); } to { transform: translate3d(0, var(--sl-pat-ty, -10px), 0); } }

effects.label: Scroll ↓ Down
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-scroll-down { from { transform: translate3d(0, var(--sl-pat-ty, -10px), 0); } to { transform: translate3d(0,0,0); } }

effects.label: Scroll ↗ NE
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-scroll-ne { from { transform: translate3d(var(--sl-pat-tx, -10px), 0, 0); } to { transform: translate3d(0, var(--sl-pat-ty, -10px), 0); } }

effects.label: Scroll ↖ NW
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-scroll-nw { from { transform: translate3d(0,0,0); } to { transform: translate3d(var(--sl-pat-tx, -10px), var(--sl-pat-ty, -10px), 0); } }

effects.label: Scroll ↘ SE
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-scroll-se { from { transform: translate3d(var(--sl-pat-tx, -10px), var(--sl-pat-ty, -10px), 0); } to { transform: translate3d(0,0,0); } }

effects.label: Scroll ↙ SW
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-scroll-sw { from { transform: translate3d(0, var(--sl-pat-ty, -10px), 0); } to { transform: translate3d(var(--sl-pat-tx, -10px), 0, 0); } }

effects.label: Breathe
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-breathe { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 40% { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(1.035); } 70% { opacity: 0.75; transform: scale(1.012); } }

effects.label: Drift
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-drift { 0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0,0,0); } 25% { transform: translate3d(-6px,-3px,0); } 50% { transform: translate3d(-10px,2px,0); } 75% { transform: translate3d(-4px,5px,0); } }

effects.label: Glass Shine
effects.css: @keyframes sl-pat-glass { 0%, 100% { filter: brightness(1) contrast(1); } 50% { filter: brightness(1.25) contrast(1.08); } }
